recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core FHIR. If a future work group wants automatic IG Publisher fetching of raw CodeSystem or ValueSet content at canonical URLs, track that as an IG Publisher/tooling behavior change rather than a core source correction.
issue_request: FHIR-17694 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request from STU3, applied for R5, asking that the IG builder directly resolve CodeSystem and ValueSet resources from canonical URLs that return raw FHIR resource content so profiles and value-set expansions could use their titles/codes.
initial_application: No source or git-history commit explicitly mentions FHIR-17694. Older canonical-reference guidance from FHIR-9179 already documented registry lookup and direct URL fallback, and the Jira's only later comment says the requested direct feature was not anticipated and would be done a different way.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes confirm FHIR-17694 was accepted in an IG tooling block vote, not as a specific core-page wording change. Current source/reference guidance now says package-contained canonical references resolve first through package dependencies, may use IG-defined manifests, and otherwise can use local configuration, registries/repositories, or direct literal-URL fallback. CodeSystem and ValueSet pages already say their url elements are stable canonical identifiers and ideally resolvable, while allowing that this is not always possible.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Adding CodeSystem/ValueSet-specific IG-builder wording would duplicate the canonical-reference section and could imply a core requirement that applications or the IG Publisher perform live direct URL retrieval, which current source intentionally does not require.
